author: Vox
description:
There’s been a lot of confusion lately about mail-in voting, thanks in part to Trump targeting it and changes at USPS. But you should still “vote by mail. If you already have a mail ballot, like some people do, you should vote. The longer answer is that might not always be true. So if you want to vote by mail, do it quickly.”

Vox’s Zack Beauchamp explains that despite Supreme Court cases challenging mail-in voting, everyone should continue to vote by mail anyway.
